title: DragonOS Resolute_R1
content: DragonOS is a Lubuntu-based desktop Linux distribution which is focused on software defined radio (SDR). It provides a pre-installed suite of the most powerful and accessible open-source SDR software. DragonOS has verified support for a range of inexpensive and powerful SDR hardware, including RTL-SDR, HackRF One, LimeSDR, BladeRF and others.
